result.summary: The image shows a well-maintained urban intersection with wide sidewalks, high-visibility zebra crosswalks, and signalized traffic control. The environment is characterized by high-density commercial buildings and clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Vehicle turning speed
hazards.description: The wide intersection layout may encourage vehicles to make turns at speeds that are unsafe for pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners, particularly the right side near the Primark store.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: A busy urban commercial intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the multi-lane crossing and presence of large vehicles create potential sightline hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A bus and a large truck are positioned near the crosswalk, which can block the line of sight between pedestrians and other approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left and center of the roadway approaching the crosswalk

hazards.name: Wide Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a median or refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking or stopping zones immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The image depicts a dense commercial urban intersection with wide sidewalks and signalized pedestrian crossings. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and pedestrian signals are present, the environment lacks physical traffic calming measures such as curb extensions or medians to reduce exposure.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Faded pavement markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings in the immediate foreground appear less distinct than the zebra crossing on the right.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians with a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.
